units.name: plugin and marketplace manifest
units.purpose: publishes ABBD as a Claude Code plugin from this repository
units.responsibility: fixes the marketplace and plugin names and the plugin source path

units.name: project.yaml
units.responsibility: fixes project.yaml, which abbd sync runs without asking

units.name: extraction JSON
units.purpose: is what every project extraction script and supplement must print
units.responsibility: fixes the units and relations JSON; unknown fields are rejected

units.name: blueprint files
units.purpose: lets a human read the topology and tools read it without the CLI
units.responsibility: fixes the blueprint file names and graph.json, whose watermark tells CURRENT from STALE

units.name: unit files
units.purpose: is the topology of the merged code as reviewable files
units.responsibility: fixes the unit file frontmatter: anchors, facts with their origin and source, relations with their evidence

units.name: /abbd
units.purpose: brings the stored topology into work under any mode, without routing it
units.responsibility: queries the blueprint with abbd explain, path and impact before the work, records readers' couplings and the human's statements, and ends with abbd sync and abbd diff in the PR

units.name: /abbd-setup
units.purpose: bootstraps ABBD on a repository without asking the human
units.responsibility: drives build-the-lever for the extraction script, the swarm and how supplement with evidence and parents, abbd setup and abbd understand

units.name: internal/bootstrap
units.purpose: lays the semantic supplement over the script result
units.responsibility: matches supplement units to script units by shared anchors, refuses ties, a coupling without evidence and an evidence unit that would merge into a script unit

units.name: abbd CLI
units.purpose: lets the human and the agent work the lever from a terminal
units.responsibility: parses argv against the command table, runs setup, install, sync, record, understand, explain, path, impact, diff, evidence and status, and renders the blueprint after every write

units.name: internal/extract
units.purpose: is the trust boundary where extraction JSON becomes typed units
units.responsibility: validates kinds, names, anchors, unique keys and contract-only signatures, and marks code facts EXTRACTED and stated intent INFERRED

units.name: internal/gitx
units.purpose: reads the few git facts ABBD needs without touching the user's index
units.responsibility: snapshots the working tree as a tree object, diffs snapshots for renames, reads files at a revision and finds the merge base

units.name: internal/identity
units.purpose: keeps design unit IDs stable across re-extraction
units.responsibility: matches units by kind and two shared anchors or an identical set, mints IDs from the high-water mark, follows renames, records merge candidates, and decides which facts re-extraction may overwrite

units.name: internal/model
units.purpose: is the shared vocabulary of design units and their evidence
units.responsibility: defines Unit, Fact, Relation, Edge and Anchor, the three origins and the source a stated fact carries, the kinds and their directories, and KIND-NNNN IDs

units.name: internal/screen
units.purpose: shows a human the architecture as it is
units.responsibility: builds a deterministic two-level drawing, the overview of top-level units and one inside per module, and renders the watermarked blueprint

units.name: internal/store
units.purpose: persists ABBD state as reviewable files under .abbd/
units.responsibility: is the only reader and writer of every .abbd file layout: no-op-if-equal writes, ID high-water minting, input hashes, and units at a revision

units.name: internal/topology
units.purpose: answers questions about the stored topology
units.responsibility: explains one unit, finds the shortest path between two units with its weakest origin, computes the impact of a change in direct and far tiers, and the difference between two revisions' topologies
